latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the Learn Social Studies UI Kit for React.
- Provides standardized CSS variables, typography, and color rules for Learn Social Studies branding.
- Includes support for light theme by default with optional dark theme via the data-theme attribute.
- Supplies reusable component conventions for buttons, inputs, cards, badges, and more.
- Offers guidance on file layout, font loading, and usage instructions for consistent UI across React projects.
- Emphasizes separation of style from business logic and encourages use of scalable, maintainable UI patterns.
